lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn4Zn4Bi4 (reduced formula MnZnBi) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 8-fold coordination for Bi, Mn, and Zn centers, each surrounded by four Bi, Mn, and Zn neighbors; these environments adopt body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner- and face-sharing between like 8-vertex Bi, Mn, and Zn coordination polyhedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites.
